svg.title: AI PDF Reader architecture
svg.desc: React frontend, FastAPI backend with ingestion, hybrid retrieval and generation, Supabase data plane and external AI services, annotated with RAG eval metrics.
svg.text: Upload PDFs, read them with related passages from your other PDFs, chat, insights and podcasts, grounded by hybrid RAG.
Backend · FastAPI (Docker on Render · uvicorn :8000 locally)
Side panel: /api/recommendations/{id} (open PDF excluded, relevance floor)
Every DB query scoped by user_id
Chat only: LLM rewrites the query
Side panel: open PDF excluded, persona
